name: rm refuses a worktree with uncommitted or untracked changes

attrs.quote: throw Object.assign(new Error('Worktree has uncommitted or untracked changes.'), {
attrs.scope: Git worktrees with any git status --porcelain entry, untracked files included, without --force
attrs.note: The check runs git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all --ignore-submodules=none, so changes inside submodules count.
